record.field: Needed for the site to work: signing in, keeping your cart, remembering your language and recording the cookie choice you make here. These cannot be switched off.
Remember choices you make so the site can behave the way you prefer, such as a chat widget or an embedded map. Refusing these keeps the site working, with fewer conveniences.
Help us understand how the site is used, by collecting visit and interaction data. This is used to improve the site, not to advertise to you.
Used to measure advertising and to show you relevant adverts on this and other sites. This is the category that involves sharing data with advertising partners.

Holding area for cookies and services found on the site but not yet classified. Nothing here is put to visitors, because a purpose that cannot be described cannot be consented to: it stays refused until someone reviews it.
